scope: E14 full frozen pools. Raw complete coordinate evidence remains at hashed remote reports; this publication preserves endpoint IDs and quantum values. 2026 of 2026 selected endpoints converged; 4608 original proposals. Off reused at five requests, not five independent pools.

e14_homo_correct.scope: Single trained seed; Wilson intervals describe proposal sampling only. Off proposals rescored at three goals are not independent repeats. Across-request unique counts are system pool counts, not single-goal success rates. Quantum task times exclude upstream generation/relaxation/training. DFT singlepoints do not certify optimized identity.

correct_vs_mismatched.scope: Supplementary target-label reassignment, not new proposals. Each active-condition pool is scored against every other requested value, equally weighted. Shared seed and candidate resampling across targets; no training-variance estimate.

homo_vs_subset.scope: Fixed checkpoints, paired inference-seed blocks and candidate slots shared across target requests. 4000 bootstrap draws, seed1614. Failures remain zeros in full-proposal hit vectors. Intervals describe sampling, not training variance. Successful-endpoint MAE is conditional on different accepted populations.

homo_condition_vs_off.scope: Fixed training seed; paired inference-seed block and candidate-slot bootstrap (4000, seed1521). The same off proposals are shared across targets in every replicate. E12 uses one audited off pool across arms; E14 pairs each arm with its own off pool. Does not estimate training variance. MAE conditions on successful quantum endpoints.
